conclusion: The wire decoder slices each fixed X field, rejects malformed UTF-8 and non-NFC before the typed catalog runs semantic validation.

A directly constructed Java Text is an intermediate representation, not a validated wire. The semantic byte count alone does not establish scalar correctness. The outbound fixed codec rejects malformed UTF-16 before producing bytes and applies NFC per SS322.

Existing SEM001 tests direct semantic character/byte limits. A named on-wire test at these two exact offsets with compiler-independent bytes and adjacent fields is unrepresented among the checked ordinary proofs.
